component.name: Teams Office
component.summary: Teams client with Word and Excel access for local AI agents

description.p: Teams Office is Teams for Linux, an unofficial Microsoft Teams client, with a bridge that lets AI agents on the same computer work in the Word documents and Excel workbooks open in Teams.

ul.li: Read and change Excel cells, values and formulas
Read Word paragraphs and replace their text
Changes go through an Office add-in, so Office saves them and other people editing the same file see them
Agents connect over the Model Context Protocol (MCP) through a private local socket

description.p: It installs next to the regular Teams for Linux Flatpak, with its own sign-in and settings. This is an unofficial Flatpak build.
More Word and Excel editing tools for local agents. Teams channel file reads and writes, including large files, and live editing in SharePoint's Markdown editor can be turned on in config.json.
The bridge now starts after its local certificate expires, lists documents promptly while an add-in pane is still loading, and reports uploads Microsoft rejected as not saved.
Teams for Linux 2.27.0 with Word and Excel access for local agents.
